name: activity-feed-01
title: Activity Feed 01 - A Chronological Record Of What Happened
description: A chronological list of what happened, where an actor, an action, a target and a moment are four separate props because a record of what happened has four parts and no others, and a fifth field would be a claim about the reader's product. Rows become real controls when the caller passes a handler, the moment is printed exactly as passed with the machine value on the time element, and grouping by day renders a heading per day with a nested list rather than a merged row. The Block never sorts, because order is a claim about what happened first.
